result.rationale: Pregnant patient at 26 weeks reports 4 days of ibuprofen 400 mg TID, which FDA advises avoiding at ≥20 weeks due to fetal kidney/amniotic fluid risk; exposure exceeded 48 hours, so a clinician should assess and decide whether amniotic-fluid monitoring is warranted. Patient feels well, shoulder improved, fetal movements usual, and no red flags reported, so messaging assessment can begin; advise stopping ibuprofen and using clinician-approved alternatives.
